name: HT16K33 Character Display
description: The `ht16k33_char` display platform drives character displays built around the Holtek HT16K33 LED driver over [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/). The chip can drive any array of LEDs, but this platform only knows displays whose segments are wired as characters.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the display. With several displays, the address of the first one. Defaults to `0x70`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/), only needed with more than one bus.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `10s`.

config_entries.label: Device
config_entries.description: The display board, one of the values in [Supported Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/ht16k33_char/#supported-displays).

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

config_entries.label: Add Characters
config_entries.description: Characters to add to the font, or to redraw differently. See [Adding or Changing Characters](https://esphome.io/components/display/ht16k33_char/#adding-or-changing-characters).

config_entries.label: Intensity
config_entries.description: The brightness of the displays, from 0 (dimmest) to 15 (brightest). Defaults to `15`.

config_entries.label: Lambda
config_entries.description: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the display. See [Rendering Lambda](https://esphome.io/components/display/ht16k33_char/#rendering-lambda) for more information.

config_entries.label: Max Buffer Length
config_entries.description: The longest message, in bytes, that the lambda can print. Must hold every character of the message, including the decimal points and colons, and a multi-byte character such as `°` takes two bytes. From 4 to 64. Defaults to `8`.

config_entries.label: Secondary Displays
config_entries.description: Further displays on the same bus that continue the message after the first one, in the order they are placed. Each entry takes an **address** (**Required**, int). Up to seven.
